activity_summary: You came into the tiring-house and found the three rolls already on the trestle. Humphrey would not start until John was in the room. Nick wanted the new cue in his mouth at once. You told him to wait. No one was painted yet. John was still in the yard.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the room off the cue until John was in, chose the rewritten cue, and named the eightpence as a cost.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Had the rolls out, copied the cue that stands, and left the weight on them.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Waited, spoke the new cue once to the paper, and kept the old line unsaid.

entities.name: the three rolls
entities.context: Mentioned in Found the three rolls on the trestle

facets.activity: Rehearsed the three rolls of the king play

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not start until John is in the room.

quotes.speaker: humphrey_larkham
quotes.text: I am not writing a letter until someone has chosen which letter.
